A modern, themeable WPF UI framework for .NET 10: light/dark/system themes, accent colors, restyled standard controls and 30+ custom controls (NavigationView, TabView, AutoSuggestBox, ColorPicker, file dialogs and more).

IServiceCollection registration for TypeSafeSharp, the unofficial .NET client for TypeSafe AI's System One API. Named HttpClient, configuration binding, NativeAOT safe.

Copies components from one Dataverse / Dynamics 365 solution into another, with optional required-component inclusion. Pick a source and an unmanaged target solution, select components, and copy them in one click.
